summary: This clinical trial is testing the drug tirzepatide in women who have survived a type of breast cancer called HR+ breast cancer and also have obesity, which means having a high amount of body fat. Researchers want to see if participants can follow a plan of taking the drug once a week for 6 months while tracking their weight and health. The study involves monthly check-ins, blood tests, and other health assessments. Weill Medical College of Cornell University is sponsoring this research.
